events.factual_description: Wolf Trap presents the Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra with Wynton Marsalis and the National Symphony Orchestra, conducted by James Gaffigan, at the Filene Center on Saturday, September 12, 2026 at 8:00 PM. The program includes selections by JLCO and the world premiere of Marsalis' Symphony No. 5 "Liberty," co-commissioned by the National Symphony Orchestra and Wolf Trap Foundation for America250. Wolf Trap states that the performance is part of Marsalis' final season as Artistic Director of Jazz at Lincoln Center and Music Director of JLCO.

en.why_it_matters: This is not simply another JLCO appearance. Marsalis is premiering an entirely new symphony with the National Symphony Orchestra in the DMV, commissioned for America250, while closing out his final season leading Jazz at Lincoln Center and the JLCO. The combination of new large-scale writing, jazz orchestra, full symphony orchestra and a one-night local premiere makes this one of the season's genuinely consequential DMV dates.
en.trip_verdict: S local/regional. Protect the night. For someone in the DMV this is exactly the sort of one-off performance the RADAR should surface before ordinary tour dates: a world premiere by a major living jazz composer, with JLCO and NSO together at Wolf Trap. It does not need S+ inflation to be essential locally.

es.why_it_matters: Esto no es simplemente otra aparición de la JLCO. Marsalis estrenará una sinfonía completamente nueva con la National Symphony Orchestra en el DMV, comisionada para America250, mientras atraviesa su última temporada al frente de Jazz at Lincoln Center y la JLCO. La combinación de escritura nueva de gran formato, orquesta de jazz, sinfónica completa y un estreno local de una sola noche convierte esta fecha en uno de los acontecimientos realmente importantes de la temporada en el DMV.
